issues.note: User approved the 60GB ext4 data disk. Mounted by UUID with systemd automount; 135 downloads copied and fully SHA256-verified through loopback HTTP, then switched atomically. Original files retained for rollback; no root-space reclamation claimed. About 58.9GB data-disk and 2.8GB system-disk space available. Future mobile publication must use /opt/chatq/bin/prepare-mobile-release and its data-disk paths. Monitor both filesystem capacities and mount identity.
